hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We can process the infinite stream bit by bit using the Knuth-Morris-Pratt failure function.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Precompute the prefix function pi for the pattern array of bits.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Maintain the current matching state j as bits arrive from stream.next(). Return the start index when j reaches len(pattern).

hints.title: Implementation

variables: L: position of first occurrence in stream
complexity.notes: Online KMP automaton consuming stream tokens.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Buffering and re-matching leads to O(m * L) quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) table for failure function pi.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use KMP failure table to handle unbounded online streaming input.
